violations.description: Handwashing lavatory supplies. — --Handwash lavatory was not supplied with supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder or bar soap. Place hand soap dispenser near hand sink.--Handwash lavatory was not supplied with supply of individual disposable towels, continuous towel supply system, or heated air-drying device. Recommend mounting a paper towel dispenser at hand sink.
Water Supply. — --Hot water generation was not sufficient to meet the peak demands throughout the food establishment. Water pump not working at time of inspection.
Clean, proper use, storage, sanitizing solution (2 pts deducted)
